_about: Accuracy scenarios for the scheduling agent.
Each one is a case the catalog was deliberately built to break: near-duplicate
appointment types, duplicated provider names, capability-gated services, providers
at several sites, new-patient and referral rules, and specialties the clinic
advertises but has nobody to staff.
The caller's lines are scripted and the agent drives the same compiled graph the
voice pipeline runs. Assertions are on the OUTCOME -- what got booked, and whether
it was legal -- not on the wording, which is not the thing under test.

scenarios.why: Symptom to specialty is world knowledge; the referral and the imaging gate are policy.
script: Hola, llevo semanas con dolor en la rodilla y mi traumatologo me mando una resonancia.
Me llamo Ana Ruiz, y ya he venido antes.
Si, tengo el volante de la derivacion.
Lo que sea mas pronto me viene bien.
Perfecto, esa me va bien.

scenarios.why: New patients may only book new-patient types, and only with providers who accept them.
script: Hi, I have never been to this clinic before and I would like a general check-up.
My name is Marcus Webb.
Whatever is soonest, thanks.
That works.

scenarios.why: Three provider names are duplicated. A name is not a key, so the agent must ask.
script: Buenos dias, queria pedir cita con la doctora Maria Garcia.
Soy Elena Ortiz, ya soy paciente.
La pediatra, es para mi hijo.
Un control del nino, si.
Cualquiera de las dos me sirve.

scenarios.why: Dr. David Chen practises at four sites; his echocardiogram is only bookable where there is imaging.
script: Hola, necesito un ecocardiograma con el doctor David Chen.
Soy Ramon Ferrer, ya soy paciente suyo.
Si, tengo la derivacion.
Me da igual la sede, la que antes tenga hueco.
Vale, resérvela.

scenarios.why: Time is a constraint, not a final step. The agent must search across combinations.
script: Hi, I need to see someone about my asthma as soon as possible.
It's Dana Ruiz, I'm an existing patient.
I really don't mind who I see, just the earliest slot.
I'll take it.

scenarios.why: Refining must be another tool call inside the node, not a backwards transition.
script: Buenas, necesito una limpieza dental.
Soy Julia Pons, ya soy paciente.
Me da igual el dentista, lo que antes haya.
Uf, esas horas no me van bien.
Solo puedo los martes por la tarde.
Esa si, gracias.

scenarios.why: Annual Physical and Annual Wellness Visit are semantically identical; only a question separates them.
script: Hola, me toca la revision anual.
Soy Pere Soler, ya soy paciente.
La de siempre con mi medico de familia.
Perfecto.

scenarios.why: A new patient cannot book a follow-up type; the agent must redirect rather than fail.
script: Hi, I'd like to book a follow-up visit please.
Actually I've never been seen there before. I'm Tom Baker.
Okay, whatever you can do.
Sounds good.

scenarios.why: Referral-gated types must not be booked without one.
script: Hola, quiero una consulta con el cardiologo.
Soy Nuria Salas, ya soy paciente.
No, no tengo ninguna derivacion de mi medico.
Ah, vale, entonces lo dejamos.

scenarios.why: The agent must explain the capability gate and offer the sites that do have it.
script: Buenas, necesito una radiografia en la clinica de Sunset.
Soy Ivan Roca, ya soy paciente.
Ah, no sabia. Donde puedo entonces?
Vale, esa me sirve.

scenarios.why: A language wish is a preference, not a policy. Ranking on it is fine; filtering on it turned a bookable appointment into 'no availability'.
script: Hola, queria pedir cita de dermatologia con un medico que hable espanol.
Soy Lucia Mena, ya soy paciente.
Es una revision de un lunar.
Si, tengo la derivacion.
La primera que haya.
Perfecto, esa.

scenarios.why: Answering questions is a requirement, and it must not turn into a booking.
script: Hola, solo queria saber a que hora abre la clinica de Mission Bay.
Y el telefono?
Nada mas, gracias.

scenarios.why: Provider lookup by specialty, with no booking intent.
script: Hi, which dermatologists do you have, and are they taking new patients?
Thanks, that's all.

scenarios.why: The clinic lists eye exams but nobody offers them. Promising an appointment is the worst outcome.
script: Hola, queria una revision de la vista.
Soy Sara Vidal, ya soy paciente.
Ah, entiendo. Gracias.

scenarios.why: 'My daughter' is the signal that separates Pediatrics from Family Medicine.
script: Hola, mi hija de seis anos lleva dos dias con fiebre.
Soy Marta Gil, y ella ya es paciente de la clinica.
Es para ella, tiene seis anos.
Lo antes posible por favor.
Esa me va bien, gracias.

scenarios.why: Lab work is capability-gated to sites with a lab.
script: Buenos dias, me han mandado un analisis de sangre en ayunas.
Soy Hector Nunez, ya soy paciente.
El mas temprano que tengan.
Vale, gracias.
